note: Layout Builder Tabs registers exactly one layout plugin, 'tabs' (label Tabs, category Extra Layouts), via layout_builder_tabs.layouts.yml and core layout_discovery. Class TabsLayout extends LayoutDefault; single region 'tabs'; when the Olivero theme is active it attaches olivero/tabs. A SortByWeight Twig extension adds a 'sortbyweight' filter used by templates/tabs.html.twig to order tabs by block #weight. No configure route, no settings, no permissions, no Drush. The only persistent state is a Layout Builder section with layout_id 'tabs' stored in an entity_view_display's third_party_settings.layout_builder.sections. Medium/hard cases are grounded in that: introspection reads back the layout id of a Tabs section on a display; execution adds a Tabs section to a Layout-Builder-enabled display, verified via the live entity_view_display (getSections()->getLayoutId()). A dedicated lbt_demo content type isolates the fixtures from other agents.

evals.prompt: I want to render a set of Layout Builder blocks as tabs using the layout_builder_tabs module. What is the machine name (plugin id) of the layout/section it provides, and under which category does it appear in the Add section UI?
evals.expected_output: The layout plugin id is 'tabs' (label 'Tabs'), defined in layout_builder_tabs.layouts.yml and listed under the 'Extra Layouts' category when you Add a section in Layout Builder. Each block in the section becomes a tab.

evals.prompt: In the layout_builder_tabs module, how does the Tabs template decide the order of the tabs, and what Twig filter does it use to do it?
evals.expected_output: The tabs.html.twig template pipes the region's blocks through the custom Twig filter |sortbyweight (registered by the SortByWeight Twig extension service), which uasort()s the render array by each block's #weight. So tabs appear in block weight order.

evals.prompt: Does layout_builder_tabs have an admin settings/config form? And how does it style its tabs when the site uses the Olivero theme?
evals.expected_output: There is no configure route or settings form (configure=null). TabsLayout::build() checks the active theme and, when it is 'olivero', attaches the olivero/tabs library so the tabs inherit Olivero's styling; otherwise only the layout_builder_tabs/tabs library is attached.

evals.prompt: On this site the content type 'lbt_demo' has Layout Builder enabled on its default view display, and one of its sections is provided by the layout_builder_tabs module. Inspect the live entity view display and report the layout plugin id of that section.
evals.expected_output: The node.lbt_demo default view display has a Layout Builder section with layout_id 'tabs' (the Tabs layout, single region 'tabs').

evals.prompt: Somewhere on this site a content type's default view display uses a Tabs section from the layout_builder_tabs module (layout id 'tabs'). Inspect the entity view displays and report the machine name of the content type that has it.
evals.expected_output: The content type lbt_demo: its node.lbt_demo.default entity view display has a Layout Builder section with layout_id 'tabs'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the content type 'lbt_demo' has Layout Builder enabled on its default view display, currently with a single one-column section. Using the layout_builder_tabs module, add a Tabs section to that display so blocks placed there render as tabs. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: The node.lbt_demo default view display has a Layout Builder section whose layout_id is 'tabs' (e.g. $display->appendSection(new \Drupal\layout_builder\Section('tabs')); $display->save(); or add the Tabs section via Manage layout).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the content type 'lbt_demo' currently does NOT use Layout Builder on its default display. I want each lbt_demo node to be able to show blocks as tabs. Enable Layout Builder on the lbt_demo default view display and add a Tabs section (from the layout_builder_tabs module). Apply the change live.
evals.expected_output: node.lbt_demo.default has Layout Builder enabled and contains a section with layout_id 'tabs' (e.g. $display->enableLayoutBuilder(); $display->appendSection(new Section('tabs')); $display->save()).
